lines.en: I love travelling in the country, but I don't like losing my way.
lines.zh: 我喜欢在乡间旅行，但却不愿意迷路。

lines.en: I went on an excursion recently, but my trip took me longer than I expected.
lines.zh: 最近我作了一次短途旅行，但这次旅行所花费的时间比我预计的要长。

lines.en: 'I'm going to Woodford Green,' I said to the conductor as I got on the bus, 'but I don't know where it is.
lines.zh: “我要去伍德福德草地，”我一上车就对售票员说，“但我不知道它在那儿。

lines.en: 'I'll tell you where to get off. answered the conductor.
lines.zh: ”“我来告诉您在哪儿下车，”售票员回答说。

lines.en: I sat in the front of the bus to get a good view of the countryside.
lines.zh: 我坐在汽车的前部，以便饱览农村风光。

lines.en: After some time, the bus stopped.
Looking round, I realized with a shock that I was the only passenger left on the bus.
lines.zh: 我环视了一下身旁，惊奇地发现车里就只剩我一个乘客了。

lines.en: 'You'll have to get off here,' the conductor said.
lines.zh: “您得在这里下车，”售票员说，“我们的车就到此为止了。

lines.en: 'This is as far as we go. 'Is this Woodford Green?
'Oh dear,' said the conductor suddenly. 'I forgot to put you off.
lines.zh: “哎呀，”售票员突然说，“我忘了让您下车了。
”“没关系，”我说，“我就在这儿下吧。
”“我们现在要返回去，”售票员说。

lines.en: 'We're going back now,' said the conductor.
lines.zh: “好吧，既然如此，我还是留在车上吧。

lines.en: 'Well, in that case, I prefer to stay on the bus,' I answered.

question.en: Why did the writer not get off the bus at Woodford Green?
